concerns.text: FR-001 (Download/Parse NCBI GEO/Zenodo) lacks a dedicated implementation task. T009.1 implements 'ExternalDatasetManager' but T012 (RealAdapter) is marked [X] (complete) while T009.1 is [ ] (incomplete). The spec requires the system to download and parse real datasets; the current task state implies the ingestion logic is incomplete or the 'RealAdapter' task (T012) is falsely marked complete without the underlying manager (T009.1) being implemented.

FR-010 (LODO Cross-Validation) requires training on N-1 datasets and testing on held-out. T030 implements 'lodo_cv' but depends on T009.3 (Synthetic Multi-Dataset Generator). T009.3 is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without T009.3 generating distinct synthetic datasets, T030 cannot execute the LODO logic required by FR-010. The task chain for FR-010 is broken.

FR-004 requires training Random Forest models. T022 ('Implement train_random_forest') is marked [ ] (incomplete). While T023 (SVM) is complete, the Random Forest implementation is missing, leaving FR-004 partially unimplemented.

FR-011 (Switch metric to Pearson r for population mode) is not explicitly covered by a task. T024.1 ('calculate_metric') is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without T024.1, the system cannot dynamically switch between R² and Pearson r based on data pairing mode as required by FR-011.

FR-012 (Map metabolite names to KEGG IDs) requires a mapping table. T019.0 ('Generate kegg_mapping.tsv') is marked [ ] (incomplete). T019.2 (Map to KEGG) depends on T019.0. Without T019.0, the mapping logic in T019.2 cannot function, leaving FR-012 unimplemented.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires checksums recorded in state. T007.1 ('Implement checksum verification') is marked [ ] (incomplete). Without this, the project cannot satisfy the data hygiene requirement for synthetic data generation (T007).

T007.2 generates 'invalid' data to test rejection. The task description says 'must not be used for model training' but does not explicitly tag the rejection logic implementation (T015) as the consumer of this test data. While T015 exists, the linkage between the test data generator (T007.2) and the rejection logic (T015) is implicit. A clearer tag or description linking T007.2 to T015 would improve traceability.
